svg.title: Where a Falcon app sits
svg.desc: A Falcon app, falcon.App for WSGI or falcon.asgi.App for ASGI, sits between the server and your code. A web server such as Gunicorn, uWSGI or Uvicorn calls it for every request, and the falcon.testing client simulates requests in tests. The app routes each request by its URI template to one of your resource classes and calls a responder such as on_get(req, resp). Your middleware, with methods such as process_request, runs around each request, and error handlers added with add_error_handler turn exceptions into HTTP responses.
